about: GTA 6 'It has X, shown' (Delta, slug gta-trunkstream): in Rockstar's 'An Extended Look' (Aug 27 2026, 'captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5'), a man rides in the trunk of a car the woman has just stolen and films himself on his phone (18:12-18:24, 1092-1104 s); during the police chase that follows the screen shows a livestream overlay: LIVE 51k, then LIVE 53k, a scrolling chat ('KING OF TRUNK!!!', 'first stream!!!') and a VIEW LIVESTREAM button prompt (1104-1108 s). Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six has a trunk streamer.

lines.text: She steals a car. He's in the trunk.
So he does what streamers do. He goes live.
He even asks his chat what to do.

lines.say: His stream says live: fifty-one K.

lines.text: The chat calls him king of trunk.
There's even a button: view livestream.
lines.say: There is even a button: view livestream.
Someone typed: first stream. At fifty-three K.

lines.text: Would you watch him? Be honest. Because again,
